newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis to give Credit Foncier evidence.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis to give Credit Foncier evidence.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis will be questioned by the National Assembly's finance committee next Tuesday, December 10, according to parliamentary sources.

On Wednesday, the committee will examine a request by ruling RPR party member Jean-Jacques Guillet to set up a commission of inquiry into management errors at Credit Foncier and the role of state officials responsible for supervising the group, the sources said.
The government plans to wind down Credit Foncier after the property lender reported huge 1995 losses.
But trade unions, staff and some politicians are campaigning for a reprieve, saying the 1995 accounts were overloaded with provisions and that the group is now making a profit.
